Sandbox_DelFix_AmmoMakerDropCasings: Ammo Maker: casings drop on the ground
Sandbox_DelFix_AmmoMakerDropCasings_tool: Off: Ammo Maker never puts casings on the ground (shots, reloads, full inventory); they are simply not created. Brass catchers and casings returned into the inventory keep working. On: as in Ammo Maker. Does nothing without Ammo Maker.
Sandbox_DelFix_FarmingRotTimeMultiplier: Farming: last stage before rot, multiplier
Sandbox_DelFix_FarmingRotTimeMultiplier_: How many times longer a crop stays in its last stage (seed-bearing, still harvestable) before it rots. 1 = vanilla. Applies to plants that reach the last stage after the change; plants already in it keep their old time.
